messages:
jamal: getting reports that pages didn't go out for the last 20m, ops panicking a bit
incidentbot: ERR webhook delivery failed -> 502 to https://pager.example.com/hooks (x-request-id=abc123)
jamal: saw that. looks like the pager integration started returning 502s around 12:03 UTC, then silence
erin: customer-facing alerts were generated but no oncall page? any duplicates?
sally: support saw customers open live chats about delayed responses — at least 3 customers reported no page
vik: i'm oncall, didn't get anything. no SMS, no phone. my pager shows last page at 11:47
ops-bot: automation: routing fallback to sms-relay is OFF for this integration (config: integration.pager.fallback=false)
jamal: hmm fallback disabled. is that intentional? who toggled it?
tom: that was part of last month's config cleanup — fallback was turned off to reduce noise for noisy customers
erin: okay, short-term: we need manual paging and a temporary fallback enabled. can someone flip the flag and confirm?
vik: i'll accept manual pages. jamal — can you push manual notifications to `#ops-manual-pages`? use the inc runbook
jamal: doing manual pages now. posting stepped instructions in thread. also opening a pagerduty incident: PD-4521
incidentbot: Deploybot: noticed recent cert rotation for pager provider at 11:55 UTC — TLS handshake errors briefly observed
jamal: possible combo: provider started rejecting some webhook content after cert rotate, our retries hit a rate window and then 502s
erin: action items: (1) re-enable sms fallback (2) restart webhook worker group `pager-forwarder` (3) increase retry backoff to avoid hammering provider
tom: i'm restarting `pager-forwarder` now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/pager-forwarder` — will monitor logs
ops-bot: log snippet: `2026-03-15T12:04:02Z pager-forwarder error=post https://pager.example.com/hooks 502 Bad Gateway` (rate-limit: 429 seen earlier)
jamal: re-enabled fallback flag and pushed a small override to route to `sms-relay` for critical escalation — please validate
vik: got a manual page now (12:07 UTC) from jamal :thumbsup: — sounds like manual path ok
erin: tom — any errors after restart?
tom: after restart, worker shows healthy and backoff engaged. we'll keep backoff at x2 for now. no new 502s in logs for the last 3m
sally: notifying affected customers with a short status message. I'll log the impact: delayed pages for ~20m, manual ops mitigated, post-incident follow-up planned
jamal: creating retro ticket and assigning to eng-infra to: (A) add automatic fallback enablement on webhook failures, (B) improve retry jitter, (C) alert when integration error rate > 1% over 5m
erin: also add integration smoke test in deploy pipeline that exercises webhook handshake after cert rotations
vik: please ensure oncall handoff note includes that manual paging may be required during integration incidents
tom: adding a short runbook patch now to `docs/incidents/pager-integration.md`
jamal: ok closing active page loop — if anyone sees missed alerts, ping me. great work triaging quickly.
vik: thanks all. i'd like a quick postmortem once infra has root cause. tagging eng-infra and security to review cert rotation process
sally: posted customer message and support ticket updates. will add copies to the incident ticket
incidentbot: Incident PD-4521 created by jamal — status: mitigated -> followup required
jamal: end of thread — followups: retro ticket ENG-1298, runbook patch, smoke test. low customer impact overall but we need to harden automation.
